title: Sales & Profit Intelligence

breakdown.empty: No data for this breakdown in the selected period.
breakdown.unusableHint: This dimension does not segment the selected period, so it cannot be analysed.
breakdown.beforeReturns: Breakdown values are before returns that cannot be attributed to a product. The difference shows in Net Sales above.
breakdown.uncategorisedWarning: {{percent}} of sales has no category, so the category breakdown is incomplete.

matrix.title: Product performance matrix
matrix.method: The split uses the median net sales and median margin of the selected period itself, not fixed figures. Classification therefore changes as the period changes.
matrix.starHint: Sales and margin both above the median
matrix.volume_low_marginHint: Sales above the median but margin below
matrix.margin_opportunityHint: Margin above the median but sales below
matrix.underperformerHint: Sales and margin both below the median
matrix.empty: Not enough products to build a meaningful matrix.
matrix.needsProfit: Profit permission is required to build the matrix.

rankings.title: Product rankings
rankings.empty: Not enough data for this ranking.
rankings.needsComparison: Choose a comparison period to see growth and decline.

sizes.title: Size analysis
sizes.pickType: Choose a product type to see size analysis
sizes.notApplicable: This product type does not use comparable sizes, so there is no size analysis.
sizes.scopeNote: Scoped to "{{productType}}" because size ranges differ between types. Colour-only and one-size products are excluded.
sizes.summary: {{sold}} sizes sold in the period · {{stock}} sizes currently in stock
sizes.soldOutWarning: {{count}} sizes sold in this period and now have no stock.
sizes.empty: No size-level sales or stock for this type
sizes.ratioHint: Units sold in the period as a share of current stock.
sizes.pickTypeWhy: Size ranges are not comparable across types: shoe sizes, bag sizes and one-size products cannot be read on the same axis, so the analysis covers one type at a time.
sizes.notApplicableFor: Size analysis is not available for “{{productType}}”
sizes.notApplicableWhy: This type does not use comparable sizes, or its products are colour-only and one-size.
sizes.emptyWhy: No sized sales were recorded in the selected period, and no sized stock exists for this type right now.
